answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics We assess retrieval performance using several metrics: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) calculates the average rank of gold passages. Normalized Discounted Cumulative@3 (NDCG) evaluates the top-3 retrieval results by considering both relevance and rank. Recall@k reflects whether the retriever successfully identifies the gold passages within top-k results.
